newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST BOURSE SPECIAL DEAL LIFTS TURNOVER.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST BOURSE SPECIAL DEAL LIFTS TURNOVER.

text.p: Turnover on the Bucharest stock
exchange on Wednesday climbed 3.15 billion lei from the
previous session to 11.44 billion thanks to a special trade in
first-tier Azomures fertiliser maker.
The special trade -- struck outside the market and then
reported to the exchange -- also helped Azomures end the day
200 lei firmer at 3,700. The deal involved 1.6 million shares
worth a total 5.92 billion lei.
The other three first-tier listings closed lower under a
wave of selling.
"Buyers were no longer willing to pay the very high price
levels high-caps had reached and their mood triggered a heavy
selling in late trading, depressing prices," said a trader.
The other chemical plant, Oltchim , closed at
2,200 lei, down from 2,800. Pharmaceuticals companies
Antibiotice and Terapia also fell, losing
450 and 1,200 lei respectively to end at 6,000 and 6,200.
Market operators said they expected further price drops on
the first tier in the two sessions left to the end of the week.
Trading on the second tier was rather sluggish, with 11 of
the 31 listings having no trade and four stocks suspended
pending announcements of their 1996 financial results.
Armatura plumbing equipment producer and dye maker
Policolor dominated the second section with turnover
levels of 323 million and 518 million lei respectively.
Armatura shed 450 lei to close at 2,050 and Policolor --
which rejoined the market on Wednesday after suspension --
ended at 4,200 lei, 800 higher on its previous close.
Newcomer Navlomar ship broker ended at 50,000 lei, flat on
its opening quote, in low trading.
Two unofficial bourse indices, the VAB and the BIG, drifted
lower for the first time in weeks, dropping 6.9 and 7.59
percent respectively from the previous session. The BIG
first-tier index slipped by 10.73 percent to 3,294.73 points.
-- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
